meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 把设计(截图、网址或代码)对照十个好设计原则逐条打分,附上具体依据;随后判定该新建、微调还是重做,并生成一份下一步行动提示。整个过程会产出纪要,但不会替你写代码。
howto.when: 当你说“审计这个设计”“设计评审”“这 UI 好不好”等,或要求对照 Rams 原则给批评意见并把它变成行动方案时,它就会启动。

say.text: 帮我按 Rams 十原则审计这个页面
say.note: 它会按原则打分并给出结论。

say.text: 评审这个界面,并输出一份修改计划
say.note: 会生成 verdict 和下一步提示。

say.text: 判断这个 UI 该微调还是重做

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scoring each with evidence, deciding NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN, and generating a ready-to-use /make-plan prompt. It produces audit files but does not write code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design", "design review", "is this UI good", or ask for a Rams-based critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this page against Rams' ten principles.
say_en.note: It scores each principle and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Review this UI and hand off a change plan.
Tell me whether to refine or redesign this UI.
